title: Verify Phase 0.5 completion — extensions, settings, AI config
spec:
Verify the remaining Phase 0.5 items:

1. EXTENSIONS CHECK:
   Run: list all installed Cursor/VS Code extensions.
   Expected: 16+ extensions including Python, ESLint, Prettier, Docker, GitLens, Ruff, Markdown.
   Report exact count and list.

2. SETTINGS CHECK:
   Read Cursor user settings.json.
   Verify these are set: formatOnSave=true, editor.rulers=[100], terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.osx=zsh, python.analysis.typeCheckingMode=basic.
   Report any missing.

3. AI MODEL CHECK:
   Report current AI model settings: primary model, agent mode enabled, MCP enabled, iterate-on-lints enabled.

4. RULES CHECK:
   Run: ls .cursor/rules/ | wc -l
   Expected: 26 (22 CodeGuard + 3 builder + 1 comms-protocol).
   Report exact count.

Write result to .comms/outbox/RESULT-TASK-2026-0526-001.json per the comms protocol.
